title: Scaffold Django project and module apps
description: Django 5 + DRF project with apps: accounts, courses, attendance, reports, notifications, audit, core.

title: Docker Compose setup (Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Nginx)
description: One command brings up the full stack locally and on staging.

title: Jenkins pipeline: lint, pytest with coverage, SonarQube, Docker build
description: Pipeline runs on every pull request; merge blocked on failure.

title: Seed data script (2,000 students, 100 faculty, timetable)
description: Used for demo, system tests and load tests.

title: As a user, I want to log in with my institute ID and password so that I see my role dashboard
description: AC: valid credentials load the correct dashboard; invalid credentials show an error; no session on failure. SRS SAMS-F-001. Tests: UT_AUTH_01, IT_AUTH_01, ST_AUTH_01.

title: As an admin, I want each user restricted to their role's screens and APIs so that data stays protected
description: AC: Student token gets 403 on faculty/admin endpoints; enforced server-side. SRS SAMS-F-002, SR-004. Tests: IT_AUTH_02, ST_SEC_04.

title: As the system, I want to lock an account for 15 minutes after 5 failed logins so that brute force is blocked
description: AC: 6th attempt returns lockout message; login rejected until timeout; event logged. SRS SAMS-F-003. Tests: UT_AUTH_03, UT_AUTH_04.

title: As a user, I want to reset a forgotten password through an email link so that I can regain access
description: AC: link expires in 30 minutes and works once; same response for unknown emails. SRS SAMS-F-004. Tests: UT_PWR\_\*, IT_PWR\_\*, ST_PWR_01.

title: As a user, I want my session to expire after inactivity and on logout so that my account is safe on shared PCs
description: AC: expired token rejected; logout blacklists refresh token. SRS SAMS-SR-003. Tests: IT_AUTH_03, IT_AUTH_04.

title: As an admin, I want to create courses and sections so that attendance can be organised by class
description: AC: unique course code; sections linked to a course. SRS SAMS-F-014. Tests: UT_CRS_01, IT_CRS_01.

title: As an admin, I want to build a weekly timetable and assign faculty so that sessions are generated automatically
description: AC: no faculty or section clashes; end after start. SRS SAMS-F-015, F-016. Tests: UT_CRS_02 to UT_CRS_04.

title: As an admin, I want to bulk-enroll students from a CSV so that setup is fast
description: AC: valid rows enrolled, invalid rows reported with reason. Tests: UT_CRS_05, IT_CRS_03.

title: As a faculty member, I want to see today's sessions with the roll list so that I can take attendance in class
description: AC: only students enrolled in that section; list matches timetable slot. SRS SAMS-F-005. Tests: UT_ATT_01, UT_ATT_02.

title: As a faculty member, I want to mark each student Present, Absent or On Duty on one screen so that roll call takes under a minute
description: AC: all statuses saved; 60-student save under 2 s server-side. SRS SAMS-F-006. Tests: UT_ATT_03, IT_ATT_01, ST_ATT_01.

title: As a faculty member, I want a submitted session protected from double marking so that records stay correct
description: AC: re-submit returns 409; edits need explicit action and are audited. SRS SAMS-F-007. Tests: UT_ATT_04, UT_ATT_07.

title: As a student, I want to see my attendance percentage per course so that I know where I stand
description: AC: updated within 5 minutes of submission; P and OD count as attended. SRS SAMS-F-008. Tests: UT_VIEW\_\*, IT_VIEW\_\*, ST_VIEW_01.

title: As a student, I want to raise a correction request with a reason so that wrong marks can be fixed
description: AC: only on own records; one open request per record; faculty notified. SRS SAMS-F-009. Tests: UT_COR_01 to UT_COR_03, IT_COR_01.

title: As a faculty member, I want to approve or reject correction requests so that valid claims update the record
description: AC: approval updates record and audit log; decision notified to student. SRS SAMS-F-009. Tests: UT_COR_04 to UT_COR_06, IT_COR_02, ST_COR_01.

title: As a faculty member, I want per-student and per-course attendance reports so that I can track my classes
description: AC: correct held/attended per student; faculty limited to own sections. SRS SAMS-F-010, F-011. Tests: UT_REP_03, IT_REP_01.

title: As an admin, I want date-range attendance summaries so that I can review any period
description: AC: both end dates inclusive. SRS SAMS-F-012. Tests: UT_REP_04.

title: As a faculty member, I want a defaulter list below the configured threshold so that I can warn students early
description: AC: strictly below threshold; threshold 0 to 100. SRS SAMS-F-013. Tests: UT_REP_01, UT_REP_02, ST_REP_01.

title: As a user, I want to export reports as CSV or PDF so that I can share them
description: AC: CSV header and rows correct; valid PDF. Tests: UT_REP_05, UT_REP_06, IT_REP_02.

title: As a student, I want to be notified when my attendance falls below the threshold so that I can act in time
description: AC: nightly scan; no duplicate same-day alerts; in-app plus email. SRS SAMS-F-017. Tests: UT_NOT_01, UT_NOT_02, ST_NOT_01.

title: As a faculty member, I want to be notified of pending correction requests so that I review them quickly
description: AC: notification on request creation; email retried on failure. SRS SAMS-F-018. Tests: IT_NOT_01, UT_NOT_03, UT_NOT_04.

title: As an admin, I want to manage user accounts and roles so that the right people have access
description: AC: one role per user; role changes only by admin. SRS SAMS-F-019. Tests: UT_ADM_01, IT_ADM_03.

title: As an admin, I want to configure the minimum-attendance threshold so that reports follow department policy
description: AC: value 0 to 100; used by reports and notifications. SRS SAMS-F-020. Tests: UT_ADM_02.

title: As an admin, I want an append-only audit trail of every attendance edit so that changes are traceable
description: AC: editor, timestamp, old and new value; no update/delete path. SRS SAMS-F-021, SR-005. Tests: UT_ADM_03, UT_ADM_04, IT_ADM_01, IT_ADM_02.

title: Performance test with Locust (p95 under 3 s at target scale)
description: SAMS-NF-001, NF-006. Tests: ST_PERF_01, ST_PERF_02.

title: Security validation: ZAP scan, TLS check, access-control pen test
description: SAMS-SR-001 to SR-005. Tests: ST_SEC_01 to ST_SEC_05.

title: Accessibility and responsive audit (Lighthouse, 360px)
description: SAMS-NF-005. Test: ST_UX_01.

title: Validation report and maintenance plan
description: Test execution results, updated RTM and product maintenance plan.

title: Final project report and 15-minute demo presentation
description: Report per Jackfruit format; demo of use cases and SDLC artefacts.

title: Teacher-required sprint demo recordings
description: Record actual working-product demos: 1 minute for Sprint 1 scope, 2 minutes for Sprint 2 scope. Recordings made after the original sprint window must be labelled retrospective; do not backdate evidence.

title: Create linked GitHub Project with estimates and sprint fields
description: Maintain the linked GitHub Project with story points, actual assignees, team roles, sprint windows and evidence-based status. GitHub is the current assignment system; Jira is a reference backlog.

title: SAMS-NF-002: monitor working-hours uptime and prove availability
description: Configure external uptime monitoring for 8am–6pm Mon–Sat and retain a semester report targeting 99% availability excluding announced maintenance. Health checks are implemented; actual semester evidence remains pending. SRS SAMS-NF-002.

title: Test authentication, session and security regressions
description: Execute UC-01/UC-02 cases, lockout/reset boundaries, cookie and JWT logout revocation, CSRF, RBAC and ownership checks. Record failures and retest fixes.

title: Test course, timetable and enrollment setup
description: Execute UC-07 and roster scenarios, faculty clashes, adjacent slots, CSV row errors and enrollment concurrency.

title: Test attendance submission and audit integrity
description: Execute UC-03: P/A/OD, complete roster, duplicate submissions, authorized edits, persisted roster snapshots and append-only audit.

title: Test student views and correction decisions
description: Execute UC-04/UC-05: private percentages, no-session state, requests/duplicates, correct faculty routing, approval/rejection and audit.

title: Test reports, exports and threshold boundaries
description: Execute UC-06: per-student/course/date filters, strict threshold boundaries, CSV formula safety and valid PDF downloads.

title: Test notifications, administration and browser flows
description: Execute UC-08/UC-09, retry/dead-letter behavior, account roles, threshold configuration and all three UI workflows.

title: QA review of requirements, design and test traceability
description: Review the three revised PDFs, verify every FR/NFR maps to code and evidence, and record unresolved gaps without marking unexecuted checks passed.

title: QA release readiness and peer review
description: Review PR #1 and test evidence, confirm no critical/high unresolved defects, verify sprint/demo deliverables, and give actual approval only after review. Teacher UAT is separate.
